pairs: ipse est qui sacerdotio functus est in domo quam ædificavit Salomon in Jerusalem.
He is the one who executed the priestly office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.
when the Lord took away Judah and Jerusalem,
So the sons of Levi were Gershom,
And these are the names of the sons of Gershom:
And so these are the kindred of Levi,
Hæ autem cognationes Levi secundum familias eorum.
Now the sons of Merari were:
Isti sunt quos constituit David super cantores domus Domini,
These are the ones whom David appointed over the singing men in the house of the Lord,
in the place where the ark was located.
And they ministered before the tabernacle of the testimony with singing,
canentes donec ædificaret Salomon domum Domini in Jerusalem:
until Solomon built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem.
stabant autem juxta ordinem suum in ministerio.
And they would stand according to their order in the ministry.
Hi vero sunt qui assistebant cum filiis suis,
Truly, these are the ones who were assisting, with their sons,
the singer Heman, the son of Joel,
And there was also his brother,
Asaph, who was standing at his right,
Now the sons of Merari, their brothers,
qui ordinati sunt in cunctum ministerium tabernaculi domus Domini.
Levites who were appointed for every ministry of the tabernacle of the house of the Lord.
Aaron vero et filii ejus adolebant incensum super altare holocausti,
Truly, Aaron and his sons were burning offerings upon the altar of holocausts and upon the altar of incense,
for the entire work of the Holy of Holies,
and to pray on behalf of Israel,
et ut precarentur pro Israël juxta omnia quæ præceperat Moyses servus Dei.
in accord with all the things that Moses, the servant of God, had instructed.
Now these are the sons of Aaron:
Et hæc habitacula eorum per vicos atque confinia,
And these are their habitations according to the villages and confines,
specifically of the sons of Aaron,
according to the kindred of the Kohathites.
For it fell to them by lot.
Dederunt igitur eis Hebron in terra Juda,
And so, they gave Hebron, in the land of Judah,
and its suburbs all around, to them,
but they gave the fields of the city,
to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.
Porro filiis Aaron dederunt civitates ad confugiendum Hebron,
Then, to the sons of Aaron, they gave the cities of refuge:
Hebron, and Libnah with its suburbs,
Asan quoque, et Bethsemes, et suburbana earum.
as well as Ashan and Beth-shemesh with their suburbs.
And from the tribe of Benjamin:
as well as Anathoth with its suburbs.
omnes civitates, tredecim, per cognationes suas.
All the cities throughout their kindred were thirteen.
Filiis autem Caath residuis de cognatione sua dederunt ex dimidia tribu Manasse in possessionem urbes decem.
Now to the sons of Kohath, those remaining from their kindred, they gave ten cities, from the one half tribe of Manasseh, as a possession;
Porro filiis Gersom per cognationes suas de tribu Issachar,
and to the sons of Gershom, according to their families, from the tribe of Issachar,
and from the tribe of Asher,
and from the tribe of Naphtali,
et de tribu Manasse in Basan,
and from the tribe Manasseh in Bashan:
Filiis autem Merari per cognationes suas de tribu Ruben,
Then to the sons of Merari, according to their families,
and from the tribe of Gad,
and from the tribe of Zebulun, they gave by lot twelve cities.
Dederunt quoque filii Israël Levitis civitates,
Also, the sons of Israel gave, to the Levites,
and they gave them by lot,
out of the tribe of the sons of Judah,
and out of the tribe of the sons of Simeon,
et ex tribu filiorum Benjamin urbes has,
and out of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin,
these cities, which they called by their names.
et his, qui erant de cognatione filiorum Caath,
And for those who were from the kindred of the sons of Kohath,
fueruntque civitates in terminis eorum de tribu Ephraim.
the cities with their borders were from the tribe of Ephraim.
Dederunt ergo eis urbes ad confugiendum,
Then they gave to them the cities of refuge:
Sichem cum suburbanis suis in monte Ephraim,
Shechem with its suburbs on mount Ephraim,
as well as Jokmeam with its suburbs,
necnon et Helon cum suburbanis suis,
and indeed Hilen with its suburbs,
and Gath Rimmon in the same manner.
out of the one half tribe of Manasseh:
qui de cognatione filiorum Caath reliqui erant.
these in particular went to those who were remaining from the kindred of the sons of Kohath.
Filiis autem Gersom de cognatione dimidiæ tribus Manasse,
And to the sons of Gershom, from the kindred of the one half tribe of Manasseh:
as well as Ramoth and its suburbs,
truly, from the tribe of Asher:
as well as Hukkok and its suburbs,
moreover, from the tribe of Naphtali:
Cedes in Galilæa et suburbana ejus,
Kedesh in Galilee and its suburbs,
Then to the remaining sons of Merari,
trans Jordanem quoque ex adverso Jericho contra orientem Jordanis,
and also, across the Jordan opposite Jericho, facing the east of the Jordan,
de tribu Ruben, Bosor in solitudine cum suburbanis suis,
from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its suburbs,
as well as Kedemoth and its suburbs,
indeed also, from the tribe of Gad:
Ramoth in Galaad et suburbana ejus,
Ramoth in Gilead and its suburbs,
